sloka: न पापानां वधे पापं विद्यते शत्रुसूदन ।तस्मादेनं वधिष्यामि वानरं पापचारिणम् ।। ५.५२.११।।।।
transliteration: na pāpānāṁ vadhe pāpaṁ vidyate śatrusūdana ।tasmādenaṁ vadhiṣyāmi vānaraṁ pāpacāriṇam ।। 5.52.11।।।।

translations.english: "O slayer of foes it is not wrong to kill a sinner. I shall, therefore, kill the sinful vanara."
